title: Add command palette with contextual preview
purpose: Make typed commands discoverable while preserving preview-before-dispatch for risky operations.
scope: Add command palette data model over the existing typed command grammar.
Support contextual command suggestions for selected run, approval, artifact or support view.
Render preview with target, risk, authority path and expected state changes.
Ensure high-risk actions cannot bypass preview.
acceptance_criteria: Command palette suggestions map to typed commands only.
High-risk commands show preview before dispatch.
Unsafe input fails closed and is not normalized into a safe-looking command.
Command palette works in full-screen and scripted-compatible modes.
failure_modes: Shell fragment is accepted through fuzzy matching.
Palette context dispatches to wrong run or artifact.
